text: I find it easy to open up emotionally and be vulnerable with people I'm close to.
I sometimes worry that the people I care about will leave or lose interest in me.
I value my independence highly and feel uncomfortable when others rely on me too much.
I trust my close friends and partner to be honest with me, even when it's hard to hear.
I tend to avoid conflict in my relationships, even if it means not expressing my true feelings.
I often need reassurance from loved ones that they still care about me.
I feel comfortable depending on others and having others depend on me.
When I'm hurt in a relationship, I tend to pull away rather than talk about it.
I believe most people have good intentions and won't deliberately hurt me.
I actively work on communicating my needs clearly to the people I'm close to.
I find it easy to forgive people who have genuinely hurt me.
I feel deeply connected to at least one person in my life.
I sometimes feel jealous or possessive in close relationships.
I am comfortable with people having needs and expectations of me.
I prioritize keeping the peace in relationships, even at the cost of my own feelings.
I feel satisfied with the quality of my close friendships.
I feel emotionally safe enough in my relationships to be completely myself.
Past relationship wounds have made it harder for me to trust new people.
I am good at showing appreciation and gratitude to the people I care about.
I find it difficult to maintain long-term friendships or relationships over time.
